class.name: HTMLScriptElement
class.brief_description: An inert script or data element.
class.description: Represents [code]<script>[/code]. Its text and attributes are accessible to GDScript as DOM data. A runtime [HTMLLabel] can use a script with type [code]text/gdscript[/code] to select a project script from [member HTMLLabel.behavior_scripts].

members.member: The declared script or data type.
